result.finding: Layered Monolith with MVC pattern - single Spring Boot application with clear Controller/Service/Repository layers and Thymeleaf-based server-side rendered views
evidence: Clear package separation: com.photoalbum.controller, com.photoalbum.service, com.photoalbum.repository, com.photoalbum.model
MVC: 3 @Controller classes (HomeController, DetailController, PhotoFileController), Thymeleaf templates in resources/templates/
Service layer: PhotoService interface + PhotoServiceImpl implementation
Data access layer: PhotoRepository extends JpaRepository
No service discovery, API gateway, or message broker dependencies
Single docker-compose service for the application (monolith)
No microservice indicators: no Eureka, Consul, Zuul, Kafka, RabbitMQ
